An engine is compiled for one chemistry on one rocket, and burns any
[fuel](../fuels/index.qmd) that matches it. A different chemistry means a new
engine, never a flag on an existing one. Shared architecture is on the
[Rocket](../rocket.qmd) page.

None built yet.
